caption: William Bradford, An Arctic Summer: Boring Through the Pack in Melville Bay (1871)
alt: A painting of an Arctic shore: a three-masted ship lies beyond a field of broken pack ice, beside a pale iceberg and dark cliffs, under a heavy bank of cloud and a pink sky; a polar bear crosses the ice in the foreground near a broken spar.
bibliography: Bradford, William. An Arctic Summer: Boring Through the Pack in Melville Bay. 1871, oil on canvas, The Metropolitan Museum of Art, New York, 1982.443.1.
title: An Arctic Summer: Boring Through the Pack in Melville Bay
